title: China Urges Open Passage in Hormuz Amid Rising Tensions
description: Chinese President Xi Jinping emphasizes the need for the Strait of Hormuz to remain open amid tensions with Iran, following its closure by Iran and subsequent US naval actions. He asserts this as a vital international waterway and urges cooperation for regional peace, highlighting China’s diplomatic role in the region.
